resources.string: Deleted and edited messages, export and import
Your online status and phone number
Read and typing without anyone seeing
Extra actions when you hold a message
Calls, camera, video and photo quality
Chat list, stories, time and animations
Checks that MZGram settings survive a restart. It changes nothing else.
Show exact counts of views, reactions and members: 4777 instead of 4.8K.
An empty chat shows only its title, without the suggested sticker to send.
In channels where you cannot post, hides the bottom bar with the mute button.
Adds Copy Photo to the menu of a downloaded photo, so it can be pasted into other apps.
Adds Set a reminder to the menu of a message you can forward. It forwards the message to Saved Messages as a scheduled message at the time you pick, which then notifies you.
Adds Forward without sender next to Forward. It opens the usual forward flow with sender names already hidden, so the message is sent as your own.

In chats and channels whose owner restricted saving content, you can forward, save and copy messages and media and take screenshots, like anywhere else. Telegram does not forward such messages, so they are sent as new messages without the original sender; media not downloaded yet is downloaded first.
Scans the photo on the device when you open its menu; if it holds a QR code, QR Code appears and shows the link or text.
Adds Details to the message menu: ids, sender, dates, forward source, file, media and data center of a message. Long press a value to copy it.
Adds Open in... to the menu of a video (Android 8 and newer). It opens the video in another app, streaming it if it is not downloaded yet.
Adds Repeat to the message menu. It forwards the same message into this chat again, or sends its text or sticker again where forwarding is not allowed.
Adds Save Message to the menu of a message you can forward. It forwards the message to Saved Messages in one tap.
Adds Delete Downloaded File to the menu of a downloaded file or video. The file stays in the chat and can be downloaded again.
A video in the media viewer pauses when the app goes to the background or the screen turns off, and resumes when you return.
Confirm voice and round video messages
Releasing the record button shows the recorded voice or round video for review, with an explicit Send, instead of sending it right away.
Media preview on chat avatar long-press
If the last message in a chat is a photo or video, long-pressing its avatar in the chat list shows that media instead of opening Chat Preview.
Videos that come in several qualities play in the original one, which uses more data.
Removes the tab bar under the chat list. My Profile, Contacts, Calls and Settings move to the chat list menu; switch accounts in Settings. Takes effect after a restart.
Shows the chat folder tabs at the bottom of the chat list, within reach of your thumb, instead of under the search field. Takes effect after a restart.
When you scroll a profile up, the avatar melts into the top of the screen. When off, it simply fades out.
On Android 14 and newer, the back gesture previews the previous screen before you release it. Takes effect after a restart.
Removes the stories row from the chat list. Stories in profiles stay. Takes effect after a restart.
The attach menu no longer starts a live camera preview; a camera button opens the camera when needed.
Pulling the chat list down past the archive row opens the archive.
Show a confirmation before a voice or video call starts.
Message times show seconds, such as 12:34:56. Applies to screens opened after the change.
Other users no longer see that you read their message or that you are typing. Your own unread counters still work as usual.

Holds an outgoing message (12 seconds, longer for photos/videos/files) before actually sending it, so composing and sending right away does not make you look online. Not recommended on an unreliable connection: a delayed message can still be waiting to send if the app closes or the network drops in the meantime.
Sends every outgoing message without a notification sound for the recipient while ghost mode is on, regardless of the per-message \"send without sound\" option.
Before opening a story for the first time (not when swiping to the next one), asks whether to turn ghost mode on first, so viewing it does not mark it as seen.
Ghost mode is off. Viewing this story will mark it as seen. Turn ghost mode on first?
Permanently deletes every deleted/edited message archived so far, and all its saved media, in every chat.
This permanently deletes the whole local archive of deleted and edited messages, including saved media. This cannot be undone. Continue?
Masks your own phone number on your own profile screen, e.g. before sharing your screen. Only changes what this device shows you; does not change who else can see your number.
Export saves the archive database as a file you choose where to put. Import replaces the current archive with a previously exported file (media files are not included).
This replaces the current local archive with the picked file. This cannot be undone. Continue?
Stops sponsored (ad) messages in channels, and the promo/proxy banner in the chat list, from being requested or shown.
Removes stacked Unicode combining marks (Zalgo-style corrupted text) from names and chat titles shown to you.

Sets your "last seen & online" privacy to Nobody, and restores your previous setting when turned off. Only works when that setting is currently Everybody, My Contacts, or Nobody with no custom exceptions.
Your last seen privacy already has custom exceptions set. Change it from Settings → Privacy instead.
Privacy settings are still loading. Try again in a moment.

In every private chat, group, channel and secret chat, keeps a local copy of another person\'s message before it is deleted, and every earlier revision of an edited one. Your own messages are not saved.

Files of saved messages are copied to Downloads/MZGram/Saved Attachments, of any size and with no total limit. Formatting and reactions are kept with the text; chats with bots are saved only while their switch is on.
Clears Telegram\'s cache on this device: messages, the chat list and the rest of the local database. They load again from the server. The MZGram archive is not cleared.

This clears Telegram\'s local cache: cached messages and the chat list, which then load again from the server. The MZGram archive (saved deleted and edited messages, and the Saved Attachments folder) is NOT cleared; use "Clear archive" for that. A message deleted on the server before it is loaded again is not saved.
The marks are shown before the time of another person\'s deleted or edited message; any text, leave empty for none. Deleted messages kept in the chat are drawn at 75% opacity.
Tap a revision to copy its text.
No saved revisions for this message.
